scripts.//// Neoffice: commit-the-build: the vite output is committed (a 4 GB instance OOM-kills on yarn build), so a plain `yarn build` must NOT rebuild when artefacts are already there. FORCE_REBUILD=1 forces it. The desk chat widget (raven/) keeps its own yarn install: it is ours, upstream removed it (#2311).
scripts.build: if [ -d 'raven/public/raven/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at raven/public/raven/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else yarn build:force; fi
scripts.native:sync: yarn native:build && cd apps/native && yarn sync
